reviews.t: Apply every day for nine days , remove and start again.
reviews.x: Never have been able to grow nails. Trick is to apply one coat every day for nine days then remove and start again. File straight across top of nail. Never file sides of nails. This product really works. I was a nail biter all my life. Can’t recommend it strongly enough. Just love it.

However, I don’t really do much with my hands but my aunt and mother do and they both used it and said it worked wonders to keep their nails strong. I couldn’t recommend this more, i’m already on my second bottle.

You just put on a few coats …. Adding to those coats during the week.  During the pandemic I grew out my natural nails. They looked horrible and I thought I’d never have pretty nails again. Now that I am able to go back to salon, I am happy (and so is my wallet) to say that I’m happy to just sport my natural, healthy, strong and most of all reasonably  long, pretty nails!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product works, strengthening nails and helping them grow after weeks or months of use.
Some reviewers report it did not work for them, with nails still breaking, chipping, or peeling.
A few reviewers mention a strong odor, though it dissipates quickly.
Some reviewers note it requires consistent daily application or several coats to get results.
One reviewer reports the product burned their nails and warns others not to buy it.
